digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / acceptance-criteria lint (P6 advisory DET)
propositions: A deterministic lexicon lint must flag AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) but NOT tagged [operator-attested]
The lint extends p6_ac_quality as advisory (never blocking) and does not add a P10, modify CANONICAL_DET cardinality, or add criteria_routing.json entries
The single-source tag matcher _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE is owned by det_operator_attested and imported by workflow_ops so the plan-time lint and completion-verifier agree on 'tagged' by construction

Self-gate eval on frozen historical AC corpus (3091 items from 556 E1 outcome-corpus tickets) measured precision ≥92% on ≥64-item flagged sample, flag rate ≤2.07%, and both known cases (tickets 115b, 8c4f) fire when tag is stripped

Both Gerrit changes (#781 eval, #782 activation) merged to main with two-vote gate (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) and zero unresolved comments; eval commit is git-ancestor of activation commit per ADR-0016 pre-registration discipline
